'''Lucas Riva Amarante Nogueira''' (born July 26, 1992) is a [[Brazil|Brazilian]] professional [[basketball]] player who currently plays for the [[CB Estudiantes|Asefa Estudiantes]] of the [[Liga ACB|ACB]]. He also holds [[Spanish nationality law|Spanish citizenship]].<ref>[http://www.acb.com/jugador.php?id=720]</ref>

==Brazilian national team==
Nogueira has played for the Brazil U-19 national basketball team at the [[2011 FIBA Under-19 World Championship]]. He was fifth in rebounds per game and second in blocks per game.

==International career==
Nogueira had played for the [[Asefa Estudiantes]] from 2009 to 2013.

==Professional career==
On April 17, 2013, Nogueira officially declared for the [[2013 NBA Draft]].<ref>http://sports.yahoo.com/news/nba--brazil-s-lucas-nogueira-has-declared-for-the-nba-draft-224857819.html</ref> Because he had initially decided to declare for the [[2011 NBA Draft]], but ultimately declined to enter it afterwards, Nogueira is not allowed to back out of the 2013 draft. Nogueira is currently projected to be drafted late in the first round, if not early in the second round.
